summary.text: All CPF members can join from age 65, up to one month before age 80. Some members join automatically.

details.heading: Age to join
details.body: All CPF members can join CPF LIFE from age 65. The latest age to join is one month before age 80.

details.heading: Automatic inclusion
details.body: You are automatically included when you start CPF monthly payouts if you were born on or after 1 January 1958 and have at least $60,000 in CPF retirement savings then.

details.heading: If you are not included
details.body: You can still choose to join CPF LIFE. There is no minimum CPF savings required, but your payout depends on your Retirement Account balance when you join.

example_phrasings: When can someone join CPF LIFE?

quotes.text: All CPF members can join CPF LIFE anytime from age 65. The latest age to join CPF LIFE is one month before age 80.

You will be automatically included in CPF LIFE when you start your CPF monthly payouts if you were born on or after 1 January 1958 and have at least $60,000 in your CPF retirement savings when you start your monthly payouts.
There is no minimum CPF savings required to join, but the amount of payout you get is dependent on your Retirement Account balances when you join CPF LIFE.
